## What's new since v6.1.6-pre.4

### New

- **Search options.** The search of the Blocked, Allowed and Redirected lists has two options under its field: **Match case**, and **Whole word**, which only finds whole parts of a host between its dots, so `example.com` finds `ads.example.com` but not `badexample.com`. The `*` (any text) and `?` (one character) wildcards still work in every mode, with a reminder next to the options. The options are remembered.
- **Search the hosts sources.** The hosts sources page has a search button that finds sources by name or address, with the same options and wildcards. The options are shared with the lists.
- **All sources of a host at a glance.** Instead of "+2", a host listed by more than two sources shows a small arrow. Tapping it shows every source of every host on the list, and tapping it again folds them back.
- **DNS recording tile without root.** The quick settings tile now starts and stops the recording without root too, and says why when the ad-blocking VPN is off.
- **Recording notification without root.** As with root, a notification shows while DNS requests are recorded and opens the log when tapped.
- **Private DNS warning without root.** With Android's Private DNS on, DNS requests go encrypted straight to its server, past the VPN, so they are neither blocked nor recorded. Starting a recording without root now warns about it.

### Improved

- **Faster searching.** The lists are searched once you pause typing, not again for every letter, which matters with millions of hosts. Spaces around the search are ignored, and `_` and `%` are searched as they are.
- **Faster ad blocking without root.** The VPN now also remembers the hosts that are not blocked, which are most of them, instead of checking the database again for each request. It keeps 16,384 hosts in memory instead of 4,096.

### Fixed

- **The Personal filter only appears when you added hosts to that list.**
- **The ad-blocking tile stays true without root** when the VPN starts or stops by itself, such as on boot, after a failure, or when another VPN app takes over.
- **Hosts listed with capitals are blocked without root too.** They were only blocked with root. The hosts to block are now stored in lower case, so both methods treat them alike.

Everything in [v6.1.6-pre.4](https://github.com/bushman74/AdAway-but-Monet/releases/tag/v6.1.6-pre.4) is included.
